  <script>
    function safeArray(value) {
      return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    }

    function uniqueStrings(values) {
      return Array.from(new Set(values.filter(Boolean).map((item) => String(item).trim()).filter(Boolean)));
    }

    function toTitleCase(value) {
      return String(value)
        .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\b\w/g, (match) => match.toUpperCase());
    }

    function summarizeObjectLine(value) {
      if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return String(value || '');
      const ignored = new Set(['color', 'colorClass', 'impactClass', 'class', 'style', 'template_type']);
      return Object.entries(value)
        .filter(([key, item]) => !ignored.has(key) && item !== null && item !== undefined && item !== '')
        .map(([key, item]) => {
          if (Array.isArray(item)) return item.join(', ');
          if (typeof item === 'object') return '';
          return key.length <= 3 ? String(item) : `${toTitleCase(key)}: ${item}`;
        })
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' - ');
    }

    function renderSectionTitle(sectionNumber, titleText, subtitleText) {
      return `
        <div class="flex items-stretch gap-4 mb-8" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="w-1.5 bg-report-900 rounded-full"></div>
          <div class="py-1">
            <p class="text-report-500 font-bold tracking-[0.22em] uppercase text-xs mb-1">${sectionNumber}</p>
            <h2 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">${titleText}</h2>
            ${subtitleText ? `<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2 max-w-3xl">${subtitleText}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderHero(meta, highlights, options) {
      const badge = options?.badge || meta.documentId || meta.scope || meta.solutionCode || meta.systemId || meta.templateFamily || '';
      const subtitle = options?.subtitle || meta.subtitle || meta.company || meta.scope || '';
      const statusLabel = meta.status ? `
        <p class="font-medium text-report-500 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg">
          <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-report-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]"></span>
          ${meta.status}
        </p>
      ` : '<p class="font-medium text-white text-lg">Prepared Template</p>';
      const cells = [];
      if (options?.leadCell) cells.push(options.leadCell);
      safeArray(highlights).forEach((item) => {
        cells.push(`
          <div>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">${item.label}</p>
            <p class="font-medium text-white text-lg">${item.value}</p>
          </div>
        `);
      });
      if (cells.length < 4) {
        cells.push(`
          <div>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Status</p>
            ${statusLabel}
          </div>
        `);
      }

      return `
        <section class="min-h-[92vh] flex flex-col justify-end p-8 md:p-16 lg:p-24 hero-bg text-white relative" data-animate="zoom-in">
          <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-900/90 via-slate-900/36 to-transparent mix-blend-multiply"></div>
          <div class="relative z-10 max-w-6xl">
            ${badge ? `
              <div class="mb-6 inline-flex items-center px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-report-500/50 bg-report-500/20 text-blue-100 text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase shadow-lg">
                ${badge}
              </div>
            ` : ''}
            <h1 class="text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4 text-white drop-shadow-sm max-w-5xl">${meta.title || 'Report'}</h1>
            ${subtitle ? `<h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-light text-slate-300 mb-12 max-w-4xl leading-snug">${subtitle}</h2>` : ''}
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 border-t border-white/20 pt-8 mt-12 dark-glass rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl items-center" data-stagger>
              ${cells.slice(0, 4).join('')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      `;
    }

    function renderMetricGrid(metrics) {
      return `
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-5" data-stagger>
          ${safeArray(metrics).map((metric) => `
            <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 text-center">
              <p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">${metric.label || ''}</p>
              <p class="text-3xl font-black text-slate-800 mb-1">${metric.value || '-'}</p>
              ${metric.subtext ? `<p class="text-xs text-slate-500">${metric.subtext}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderBlockquote(text) {
      return `
        <blockquote class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 text-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden transform hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform my-10" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-report-accent to-report-500"></div>
          <p class="relative z-10 text-xl md:text-2xl font-light leading-relaxed">${text}</p>
        </blockquote>
      `;
    }

    function renderDataTable(columns, rows, options) {
      const minWidth = options?.minWidth || '1100px';
      return `
        <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto" data-animate="fade-up">
          <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse" style="min-width:${minWidth}">
            <thead>
              <tr class="bg-slate-900 text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider">
                ${safeArray(columns).map((column, index) => `
                  <th class="p-4 font-semibold ${index === 0 ? 'rounded-tl-[2rem]' : ''} ${index === columns.length - 1 ? 'rounded-tr-[2rem]' : ''}">${column}</th>
                `).join('')}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="text-sm text-slate-700 divide-y divide-slate-100">
              ${safeArray(rows).map((row) => {
                const cells = Array.isArray(row) ? row : safeArray(columns).map((columnKey) => row[columnKey]);
                return `
                  <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors align-top">
                    ${cells.map((cell) => `<td class="p-4">${cell === null || cell === undefined || cell === '' ? '<span class="text-slate-300">-</span>' : cell}</td>`).join('')}
                  </tr>
                `;
              }).join('')}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderBulletList(items, tone) {
      const dotClass = tone === 'dark'
        ? 'bg-report-accent shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(14,165,233,0.55)]'
        : 'bg-report-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.2)]';
      const textClass = tone === 'dark' ? 'text-slate-300' : 'text-slate-700';
      return `
        <ul class="space-y-4">
          ${safeArray(items).map((item) => `
            <li class="flex items-start gap-4 ${textClass}">
              <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${dotClass} mt-2.5 shrink-0"></span>
              <p class="leading-relaxed">${item}</p>
            </li>
          `).join('')}
        </ul>
      `;
    }

    function renderDarkCard(title, text, bullets) {
      return `
        <div class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border border-slate-800" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-64 h-64 bg-report-accent/10 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3"></div>
          <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-5 relative z-10">${title}</h3>
          ${text ? `<p class="text-slate-300 text-lg font-light leading-relaxed relative z-10 mb-6">${text}</p>` : ''}
          ${safeArray(bullets).length ? `<div class="relative z-10">${renderBulletList(bullets, 'dark')}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderLightCard(title, text, footerHtml) {
      return `
        <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-sm border border-slate-200" data-animate="fade-up">
          <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">${title}</h3>
          ${text ? `<p class="text-slate-700 text-lg font-light leading-relaxed">${text}</p>` : ''}
          ${footerHtml || ''}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderPieChart(chart) {
      const colors = ['#0ea5e9', '#14b8a6', '#4f46e5', '#f59e0b', '#cbd5e1', '#ef4444'];
      const items = safeArray(chart?.data || chart?.items).map((item, index) => ({
        label: item.label || item.name || `Item ${index + 1}`,
        value: Number(item.value || item.count || item.percentage || 0),
        color: item.color || colors[index % colors.length],
        desc: item.desc || item.description || item.scope || ''
      }));
      const total = Number(chart?.total) || items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0) || 1;
      let cursor = 0;
      const gradient = items.map((item) => {
        const pct = (item.value / total) * 100;
        const segment = `${item.color} ${cursor}% ${cursor + pct}%`;
        cursor += pct;
        return segment;
      }).join(', ');
      return `
        <div class="flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-8 w-full">
          <div class="w-40 h-40 rounded-full shadow-inner border border-slate-200 flex-shrink-0" style="background: conic-gradient(${gradient})"></div>
          <div class="space-y-4 w-full max-w-sm">
            ${items.map((item) => `
              <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full mt-0.5 shadow-sm shrink-0" style="background-color:${item.color}"></div>
                <div>
                  <p class="font-bold text-slate-800 leading-none">${item.label} <span class="text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">(${item.value})</span></p>
                  ${item.desc ? `<p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">${item.desc}</p>` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function normalizeProgressItems(items) {
      return safeArray(items).map((item) => ({
        label: item.label || item.name || item.title || 'Item',
        valueA: Number(item.valueA ?? item.current ?? item.di ?? item.score ?? item.value ?? 0),
        valueB: Number(item.valueB ?? item.target ?? item.do ?? 0),
        max: Number(item.max ?? item.maxScore ?? 100) || 100
      }));
    }

    function renderProgressBars(items, options) {
      const normalized = normalizeProgressItems(items);
      const labelA = options?.labelA || 'Current';
      const labelB = options?.labelB || 'Target';
      const colorA = options?.colorA || 'var(--bar-a, #3b82f6)';
      const colorB = options?.colorB || 'var(--bar-b, #14b8a6)';
      return `
        <div class="space-y-6 w-full">
          ${normalized.map((item) => {
            const pctA = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (item.valueA / item.max) * 100));
            const pctB = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (item.valueB / item.max) * 100));
            return `
              <div>
                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  <span>${item.label}</span>
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                    <span class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm" style="background:${colorA}"></span>${labelA}: ${item.valueA}</span>
                    ${item.valueB ? `<span class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm" style="background:${colorB}"></span>${labelB}: ${item.valueB}</span>` : ''}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="space-y-2">
                  <div class="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2.5 overflow-hidden">
                    <div class="score-bar h-2.5 rounded-full" style="background:${colorA};width:0" data-target-width="${pctA.toFixed(2)}"></div>
                  </div>
                  ${item.valueB ? `
                    <div class="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div class="score-bar h-2 rounded-full" style="background:${colorB};width:0" data-target-width="${pctB.toFixed(2)}"></div>
                    </div>
                  ` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderTimeline(phases) {
      return `
        <div class="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 shadow-2xl" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="relative timeline-container grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-${Math.min(Math.max(safeArray(phases).length, 1), 4)} gap-8">
            ${safeArray(phases).map((phase, index) => `
              <div class="relative z-10 border-t border-white/10 pt-7">
                <div class="absolute -top-2 left-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-900 border-4 border-report-500"></div>
                <p class="text-report-accent font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-xs mb-2">${phase.phase || `Phase ${index + 1}`}</p>
                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">${phase.title || phase.focus || 'Workstream'}</h3>
                ${phase.duration ? `<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-2">${phase.duration}</p>` : ''}
                <p class="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">${phase.focus || phase.description || phase.text || ''}</p>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderTableFromObjects(items) {
      const rows = safeArray(items);
      if (!rows.length || typeof rows[0] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rows[0])) return '';
      const keys = Object.keys(rows[0]).filter((key) => !/color|class|template_type/i.test(key));
      return renderDataTable(keys.map((key) => toTitleCase(key)), rows.map((row) => keys.map((key) => row[key] ?? '')));
    }

    function findTableBlock(value, depth) {
      if (depth > 4 || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.length && value.every((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))) {
          const keys = Object.keys(value[0]).filter((key) => !/color|class|template_type/i.test(key));
          if (keys.length >= 2) {
            return {
              columns: keys.map((key) => toTitleCase(key)),
              rows: value.map((row) => keys.map((key) => row[key] ?? ''))
            };
          }
        }
        for (const item of value) {
          const result = findTableBlock(item, depth + 1);
          if (result) return result;
        }
        return null;
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value.columns) && Array.isArray(value.rows)) return { columns: value.columns, rows: value.rows };
      if (Array.isArray(value.headers) && Array.isArray(value.rows)) return { columns: value.headers, rows: value.rows };
      if (value.tableHeaders && value.tableData) return { columns: Object.values(value.tableHeaders), rows: value.tableData.map((row) => Object.keys(value.tableHeaders).map((key) => row[key] ?? '')) };
      if (value.mapping_headers && value.mapping_table) return { columns: Object.values(value.mapping_headers), rows: value.mapping_table.map((row) => Object.keys(value.mapping_headers).map((key) => row[key] ?? '')) };
      if (value.mappingHeaders && value.mappingTable) return { columns: Object.values(value.mappingHeaders), rows: value.mappingTable.map((row) => Object.keys(value.mappingHeaders).map((key) => row[key] ?? '')) };
      for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
        const result = findTableBlock(child, depth + 1);
        if (result) return result;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function findMetricBlocks(value, depth) {
      if (depth > 4 || value === null || value === undefined) return [];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.length && value.every((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && ('label' in item) && ('value' in item))) {
          return value.map((item) => ({ label: item.label, value: item.value, subtext: item.subtext || item.description || '' }));
        }
        for (const item of value) {
          const result = findMetricBlocks(item, depth + 1);
          if (result.length) return result;
        }
        return [];
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return [];
      const nestedMetricMap = Object.values(value)
        .filter((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item) && ('value' in item) && ('label' in item))
        .map((item) => ({ label: item.label, value: item.value, subtext: item.description || '' }));
      if (nestedMetricMap.length) return nestedMetricMap;
      for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
        const result = findMetricBlocks(child, depth + 1);
        if (result.length) return result;
      }
      return [];
    }

    function collectKeyedStrings(value, depth, keyHint) {
      if (depth > 5 || value === null || value === undefined) return [];
      const hint = keyHint || '';
      const goodHint = /text|content|desc|description|summary|statement|takeaway|note|rule|rationale|purpose|context|outlook|subtitle|impact|risk|current|focus|observation/i.test(hint);
      if (typeof value === 'string') return goodHint ? [value] : [];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.every((item) => typeof item === 'string') && goodHint) return value;
        return value.flatMap((item) => collectKeyedStrings(item, depth + 1, hint));
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return [];
      return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, item]) => collectKeyedStrings(item, depth + 1, key));
    }

    function collectBulletItems(value, depth, keyHint) {
      if (depth > 5 || value === null || value === undefined) return [];
      const hint = keyHint || '';
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.every((item) => typeof item === 'string')) return value;
        if (value.every((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))) {
          return value.map((item) => summarizeObjectLine(item)).filter(Boolean);
        }
        return value.flatMap((item) => collectBulletItems(item, depth + 1, hint));
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return [];
      return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, item]) => {
        if (/items|bullets|gaps|strengths|principles|dependencies|pilots|requirements|lacks|priorities|layers|environment|primaryRisks|rules|facts|levels|scale|sources|implications/i.test(key)) {
          return collectBulletItems(item, depth + 1, key);
        }
        return [];
      });
    }

    function findChartBlock(value, depth) {
      if (depth > 4 || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (const item of value) {
          const result = findChartBlock(item, depth + 1);
          if (result) return result;
        }
        return null;
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return null;
      if (value.type === 'pie' || value.type === 'progress') return value;
      for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
        const result = findChartBlock(child, depth + 1);
        if (result) return result;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function normalizeAppendixPayload(data) {
      const rawSections = data.sections || {};
      const sections = Array.isArray(rawSections)
        ? rawSections.map((section, index) => ({
            key: section.key || `section_${index + 1}`,
            title: section.title || section.section_title || section.sectionTitle || section.titleText || `Section ${section.section_number || section.sectionNumber || index + 1}`,
            subtitle: section.subtitle || section.section_subtitle || section.sectionSubtitle || section.subtitleText || '',
            raw: section
          }))
        : Object.entries(rawSections).map(([key, section]) => ({
            key,
            title: section?.title || section?.sectionTitle || section?.titleText || section?.section_title || toTitleCase(key),
            subtitle: section?.subtitle || section?.sectionSubtitle || section?.subtitleText || section?.section_subtitle || '',
            raw: section
          }));

      const findSection = (matcher) => sections.find((section) => matcher((section.title || '').toLowerCase(), section.key.toLowerCase(), section.raw));
      const referenceSection = findSection((title, key) => /reference|output/.test(title) || /reference/.test(key));
      const purposeSection = findSection((title, key) => /purpose/.test(title) || /purpose/.test(key)) || sections[0];
      const overviewSection = findSection((title) => /overview|snapshot|dashboard|landscape|summary/.test(title)) || sections[1];
      const inventorySection = findSection((title, key, raw) => {
        if (referenceSection && raw === referenceSection.raw) return false;
        return (/inventory|register|dictionary|matrix|mapping|coverage/.test(title) || /inventory|register/.test(key)) && Boolean(findTableBlock(raw, 0));
      });
      const riskSection = findSection((title, key) => /risk|maturity|governance/.test(title) || /risk|maturity|governance/.test(key));
      const prioritySection = findSection((title) => /executive|conclusion|framing|implication|priority|target-state/.test(title));
      const observationSections = sections.filter((section) => {
        return ![purposeSection, overviewSection, inventorySection, riskSection, prioritySection, referenceSection].includes(section);
      });

      const purposeTexts = uniqueStrings(collectKeyedStrings(purposeSection?.raw, 0, 'text'));
      const purposeBullets = uniqueStrings(collectBulletItems(purposeSection?.raw, 0, 'items'));
      const overviewMetrics = findMetricBlocks(overviewSection?.raw, 0);
      const overviewBullets = uniqueStrings([
        ...collectBulletItems(overviewSection?.raw, 0, 'items'),
        ...collectKeyedStrings(overviewSection?.raw, 0, 'text')
      ]);
      const inventoryTable = findTableBlock(inventorySection?.raw, 0) || findTableBlock(data.sections, 0);
      const riskTable = findTableBlock(riskSection?.raw, 0);
      const riskItems = uniqueStrings([
        ...collectBulletItems(riskSection?.raw, 0, 'items'),
        ...collectKeyedStrings(riskSection?.raw, 0, 'text')
      ]);
      const priorityItems = uniqueStrings([
        ...collectBulletItems(prioritySection?.raw, 0, 'items'),
        ...collectKeyedStrings(prioritySection?.raw, 0, 'text')
      ]);
      const referenceTable = findTableBlock(referenceSection?.raw, 0);

      const observationCards = observationSections.map((section) => {
        const chart = findChartBlock(section.raw, 0);
        const table = findTableBlock(section.raw, 0);
        const metrics = findMetricBlocks(section.raw, 0);
        const bullets = uniqueStrings(collectBulletItems(section.raw, 0, 'items')).slice(0, 8);
        const texts = uniqueStrings(collectKeyedStrings(section.raw, 0, 'text')).slice(0, 4);
        return {
          title: section.title,
          subtitle: section.subtitle,
          text: texts[0] || '',
          bullets,
          chart,
          table,
          metrics
        };
      }).filter((card) => card.title && (card.text || card.bullets.length || card.table || card.chart || card.metrics.length));

      return {
        metadata: data.metadata || {},
        purpose: {
          title: purposeSection?.title || 'Purpose',
          subtitle: purposeSection?.subtitle || '',
          text: purposeTexts[0] || purposeBullets[0] || 'Structured report content is captured in the embedded dataset.',
          takeaway: purposeSection?.raw?.takeaway || purposeTexts[1] || purposeBullets[1] || ''
        },
        overview: {
          title: overviewSection?.title || 'Overview',
          subtitle: overviewSection?.subtitle || '',
          metrics: overviewMetrics,
          bullets: overviewBullets.slice(0, 6)
        },
        inventory: {
          title: inventorySection?.title || 'Inventory Register',
          subtitle: inventorySection?.subtitle || '',
          table: inventoryTable
        },
        observations: {
          title: 'Observations & Assessments',
          subtitle: '',
          cards: observationCards
        },
        risk: {
          title: riskSection?.title || 'Risk Posture',
          subtitle: riskSection?.subtitle || '',
          table: riskTable,
          items: riskItems.slice(0, 8)
        },
        priorities: {
          title: prioritySection?.title || 'Priority Actions',
          subtitle: prioritySection?.subtitle || '',
          items: priorityItems.slice(0, 8)
        },
        reference: {
          title: referenceSection?.title || 'Reference Map',
          subtitle: referenceSection?.subtitle || '',
          table: referenceTable
        }
      };
    }

    function heroHighlightsFor(data) {
      const meta = data.metadata || {};
      const family = meta.templateFamily || 'generic';
      if (Array.isArray(data.highlights) && data.highlights.length) return data.highlights;
      if (family === 'digital-solution') {
        return [
          { label: 'Company', value: meta.company || '-' },
          { label: 'Date', value: meta.date || '-' },
          { label: 'Status', value: meta.status || '-' }
        ];
      }
      if (family === 'cybersecurity') {
        return [
          { label: 'Company', value: meta.company || '-' },
          { label: 'Scope', value: meta.scope || '-' },
          { label: 'Date', value: meta.date || '-' }
        ];
      }
      if (family === 'automation') {
        return [
          { label: 'Plant', value: meta.plant || '-' },
          { label: 'Scope', value: meta.scope || '-' },
          { label: 'Date', value: meta.date || '-' }
        ];
      }
      if (family === 'function-group') {
        return [
          { label: 'Function Group', value: meta.functionGroup || '-' },
          { label: 'Prepared By', value: meta.preparedBy || '-' },
          { label: 'Date', value: meta.date || '-' }
        ];
      }
      if (family === 'appendix') {
        return [
          { label: 'Company', value: meta.company || '-' },
          { label: 'Plant', value: meta.plant || meta.scope || '-' },
          { label: 'Date', value: meta.date || '-' }
        ];
      }
      return [
        { label: 'Company', value: meta.company || 'Client Template' },
        { label: 'Scope', value: meta.scope || meta.plant || 'Overview' },
        { label: 'Date', value: meta.date || '-' }
      ];
    }

    function renderAppendixFamily(data) {
      const appendix = normalizeAppendixPayload(data);
      const hero = renderHero(appendix.metadata, heroHighlightsFor(data));
      const sections = [];
      sections.push(`
        <section class="col-span-12">
          ${renderSectionTitle('Section 01', appendix.purpose.title, appendix.purpose.subtitle)}
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
            <div class="lg:col-span-8 bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-sm border border-slate-200" data-animate="fade-up">
              <p class="text-lg text-slate-700 font-light leading-relaxed">${appendix.purpose.text}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="lg:col-span-4">
              ${appendix.purpose.takeaway ? renderBlockquote(appendix.purpose.takeaway) : ''}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      `);
      if (appendix.overview.metrics.length || appendix.overview.bullets.length) {
        sections.push(`
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 02', appendix.overview.title, appendix.overview.subtitle)}
            ${appendix.overview.metrics.length ? renderMetricGrid(appendix.overview.metrics) : ''}
            ${appendix.overview.bullets.length ? renderLightCard('Deterministic Basis', '', `<div class="mt-6">${renderBulletList(appendix.overview.bullets.slice(0, 6), 'light')}</div>`) : ''}
          </section>
        `);
      }
      if (appendix.inventory.table) {
        sections.push(`
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 03', appendix.inventory.title, appendix.inventory.subtitle)}
            ${renderDataTable(appendix.inventory.table.columns, appendix.inventory.table.rows, { minWidth: '980px' })}
          </section>
        `);
      }
      if (appendix.observations.cards.length) {
        sections.push(`
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 04', appendix.observations.title, appendix.observations.subtitle)}
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
              ${appendix.observations.cards.map((card) => {
                if (card.chart && card.chart.type === 'pie') {
                  return renderLightCard(card.title, card.text, `<div class="mt-6">${renderPieChart(card.chart)}</div>`);
                }
                if (card.chart && card.chart.type === 'progress') {
                  return renderLightCard(card.title, card.text, `<div class="mt-6">${renderProgressBars(card.chart.data || card.chart.items, { labelA: 'A', labelB: 'B' })}</div>`);
                }
                if (card.table) {
                  return `
                    <div class="xl:col-span-2">
                      ${renderLightCard(card.title, card.text || card.subtitle, `<div class="mt-6">${renderDataTable(card.table.columns, card.table.rows, { minWidth: '900px' })}</div>`)}
                    </div>
                  `;
                }
                if (card.metrics.length) {
                  return renderLightCard(card.title, card.text, `<div class="mt-6">${renderMetricGrid(card.metrics.slice(0, 6))}</div>`);
                }
                return renderDarkCard(card.title, card.text || card.subtitle, card.bullets);
              }).join('')}
            </div>
          </section>
        `);
      }
      if (appendix.risk.table || appendix.risk.items.length) {
        sections.push(`
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 05', appendix.risk.title, appendix.risk.subtitle)}
            ${appendix.risk.table ? renderDataTable(appendix.risk.table.columns, appendix.risk.table.rows, { minWidth: '900px' }) : renderDarkCard(appendix.risk.title, '', appendix.risk.items)}
          </section>
        `);
      }
      if (appendix.priorities.items.length) {
        sections.push(`
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 06', appendix.priorities.title, appendix.priorities.subtitle)}
            ${renderDarkCard('Action Stack', '', appendix.priorities.items)}
          </section>
        `);
      }
      if (appendix.reference.table) {
        sections.push(`
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 07', appendix.reference.title, appendix.reference.subtitle)}
            ${renderDataTable(appendix.reference.table.columns, appendix.reference.table.rows, { minWidth: '860px' })}
          </section>
        `);
      }

      return `
        ${hero}
        <main class="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 py-24 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-y-20 gap-x-8">
          ${sections.join('')}
        </main>
      `;
    }

    function renderOverviewFamily(data) {
      const summary = data.sections?.summary || {};
      const scorecard = data.sections?.scorecard || {};
      const focusAreas = data.sections?.focusAreas || {};
      const priorities = data.sections?.priorities || {};
      const roadmap = data.sections?.roadmap || {};
      const referenceMap = data.sections?.referenceMap || {};

      return `
        ${renderHero(data.metadata || {}, heroHighlightsFor(data))}
        <main class="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-6 md:px-12 py-24 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-y-20 gap-x-8">

              <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-8">

                ${renderLightCard('Roles', '', `<div class="mt-4">${renderBulletList(safeArray(data.sections?.governance?.roles).map((item) => `${item.role}: ${item.responsibility}`), 'light')}</div>`)}
              </div>
              ${renderLightCard('KPI Targets', '', `<div class="mt-6">${renderProgressBars(safeArray(data.sections?.kpis).map((item) => ({ label: item.name, valueA: Number(item.progress || 0), max: 100 })), { labelA: 'Target Progress' })}</div>`)}
            </div>
          </section>
          <section class="col-span-12">
            ${renderSectionTitle('Section 06', 'Roadmap & Risks', '')}
            ${renderTimeline(data.sections?.roadmap?.phases || [])}
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mt-8">
              ${renderDarkCard('Implementation Risks', '', safeArray(data.sections?.risks).map((item) => `${item.title} (${item.level}): ${item.mitigation}`))}
              ${renderLightCard('Open Questions', '', `<div class="mt-4">${renderBulletList(safeArray(data.sections?.openQuestions).map((item) => `${item.topic}: ${item.question}`), 'light')}</div>`)}
            </div>
          </section>
        </main>
      `;
    }

    function renderGenericFamily(data) {
      return renderOverviewFamily(data);
    }

    function getFamily(data) {
      return data?.metadata?.templateFamily || 'generic';
    }

    function buildHTML(data) {
      const family = getFamily(data);
      if (family === 'appendix') return renderAppendixFamily(data);
      if (family === 'overview') return renderOverviewFamily(data);
      if (family === 'cybersecurity') return renderCybersecurityFamily(data);
      if (family === 'automation') return renderAutomationFamily(data);
      if (family === 'function-group') return renderFunctionGroupFamily(data);
      if (family === 'digital-solution') return renderDigitalSolutionFamily(data);
      return renderGenericFamily(data);
    }

    function attachScrollAnimations() {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-animate]').forEach((element) => observer.observe(element));

      const staggerObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            Array.from(entry.target.children).forEach((child, index) => {
              window.setTimeout(() => child.classList.add('is-visible'), index * 80);
            });
            staggerObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.05 });

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-stagger]').forEach((element) => staggerObserver.observe(element));
    }

    function animateProgressBars() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.score-bar[data-target-width]').forEach((bar) => {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          bar.style.width = `${bar.getAttribute('data-target-width')}%`;
        }, 280);
      });
    }

    function attachGaugeAnimations() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.circle[data-filled]').forEach((element) => {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          element.style.strokeDasharray = `${element.getAttribute('data-filled')}, 100`;
        }, 280);
      });
    }

    function initMermaidBlocks() {
      if (!document.querySelector('.mermaid')) return;
      mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: 'default', securityLevel: 'loose' });
      mermaid.run({ querySelector: '.mermaid' });
    }

    function initMaturityChart(data) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('maturity-radar');
      if (!canvas || !data.sections?.maturity?.radarData?.length) return;
      const labels = data.sections.maturity.radarData.map((item) => item.dimension);
      const current = data.sections.maturity.radarData.map((item) => item.current);
      const target = data.sections.maturity.radarData.map((item) => item.target);
      new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'radar',
        data: {
          labels,
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Current',
              data: current,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.12)',
              borderColor: '#4f46e5',
              pointBackgroundColor: '#4f46e5',
              borderWidth: 2
            },
            {
              label: 'Target',
              data: target,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.08)',
              borderColor: '#14b8a6',
              pointBackgroundColor: '#14b8a6',
              borderWidth: 2,
              borderDash: [6, 4]
            }
          ]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } },
          scales: { r: { min: 0, max: 5, ticks: { stepSize: 1 } } },
          animation: { duration: 1200, easing: 'easeInOutQuart' }
        }
      });
    }

    function initModuleGalleries() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-gallery-target]').forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const target = button.getAttribute('data-gallery-target');
          const image = button.getAttribute('data-gallery-image');
          const mainImage = document.querySelector(`img[data-gallery="${target}"]`);
          if (mainImage) mainImage.src = image;
          document.querySelectorAll(`[data-gallery-target="${target}"]`).forEach((thumb) => thumb.classList.remove('is-active'));
          button.classList.add('is-active');
        });
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('report-data').textContent);
      const app = document.getElementById('app');
      document.title = data.metadata?.title || 'Report';
      app.innerHTML = buildHTML(data);
      attachScrollAnimations();
      animateProgressBars();
      attachGaugeAnimations();
      initMermaidBlocks();
      initMaturityChart(data);
      initModuleGalleries();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<body class="bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 font-sans leading-relaxed selection:bg-report-500 selection:text-white">
  <div id="app"></div>
  <script>
    function safeArray(value) {
      return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    }

    function uniqueStrings(values) {
      return Array.from(new Set(values.filter(Boolean).map((item) => String(item).trim()).filter(Boolean)));
    }

    function toTitleCase(value) {
      return String(value)
        .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\b\w/g, (match) => match.toUpperCase());
    }

    function summarizeObjectLine(value) {
      if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return String(value || '');
      const ignored = new Set(['color', 'colorClass', 'impactClass', 'class', 'style', 'template_type']);
      return Object.entries(value)
        .filter(([key, item]) => !ignored.has(key) && item !== null && item !== undefined && item !== '')
        .map(([key, item]) => {
          if (Array.isArray(item)) return item.join(', ');
          if (typeof item === 'object') return '';
          return key.length <= 3 ? String(item) : `${toTitleCase(key)}: ${item}`;
        })
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' - ');
    }

    function renderSectionTitle(sectionNumber, titleText, subtitleText) {
      return `
        <div class="flex items-stretch gap-4 mb-8" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="w-1.5 bg-report-900 rounded-full"></div>
          <div class="py-1">
            <p class="text-report-500 font-bold tracking-[0.22em] uppercase text-xs mb-1">${sectionNumber}</p>
            <h2 class="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">${titleText}</h2>

    }

    function renderHero(meta, highlights, options) {
      const badge = options?.badge || meta.documentId || meta.scope || meta.solutionCode || meta.systemId || meta.templateFamily || '';
      const subtitle = options?.subtitle || meta.subtitle || meta.company || meta.scope || '';
      const statusLabel = meta.status ? `
        <p class="font-medium text-report-500 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg">
          <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-report-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]"></span>
          ${meta.status}

      ` : '<p class="font-medium text-white text-lg">Prepared Template</p>';
      const cells = [];
      if (options?.leadCell) cells.push(options.leadCell);
      safeArray(highlights).forEach((item) => {
        cells.push(`
          <div>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">${item.label}</p>
            <p class="font-medium text-white text-lg">${item.value}</p>
          </div>
        `);
      });
      if (cells.length < 4) {
        cells.push(`
          <div>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Status</p>
            ${statusLabel}
          </div>

      }

      return `
        <section class="min-h-[92vh] flex flex-col justify-end p-8 md:p-16 lg:p-24 hero-bg text-white relative" data-animate="zoom-in">
          <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-900/90 via-slate-900/36 to-transparent mix-blend-multiply"></div>
          <div class="relative z-10 max-w-6xl">
            ${badge ? `
              <div class="mb-6 inline-flex items-center px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-report-500/50 bg-report-500/20 text-blue-100 text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase shadow-lg">
                ${badge}
              </div>
            ` : ''}
            <h1 class="text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4 text-white drop-shadow-sm max-w-5xl">${meta.title || 'Report'}</h1>
            ${subtitle ? `<h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-light text-slate-300 mb-12 max-w-4xl leading-snug">${subtitle}</h2>` : ''}
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 border-t border-white/20 pt-8 mt-12 dark-glass rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl items-center" data-stagger>
              ${cells.slice(0, 4).join('')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      `;
    }

    function renderMetricGrid(metrics) {
      return `
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-5" data-stagger>
          ${safeArray(metrics).map((metric) => `
            <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 text-center">
              <p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">${metric.label || ''}</p>
              <p class="text-3xl font-black text-slate-800 mb-1">${metric.value || '-'}</p>

    }

    function renderBlockquote(text) {
      return `
        <blockquote class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 text-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden transform hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform my-10" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-2.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-report-accent to-report-500"></div>
          <p class="relative z-10 text-xl md:text-2xl font-light leading-relaxed">${text}</p>
        </blockquote>
      `;
    }

    function renderDataTable(columns, rows, options) {
      const minWidth = options?.minWidth || '1100px';
      return `
        <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto" data-animate="fade-up">
          <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse" style="min-width:${minWidth}">
            <thead>
              <tr class="bg-slate-900 text-white uppercase text-xs tracking-wider">
                ${safeArray(columns).map((column, index) => `
                  <th class="p-4 font-semibold ${index === 0 ? 'rounded-tl-[2rem]' : ''} ${index === columns.length - 1 ? 'rounded-tr-[2rem]' : ''}">${column}</th>
                `).join('')}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="text-sm text-slate-700 divide-y divide-slate-100">
              ${safeArray(rows).map((row) => {
                const cells = Array.isArray(row) ? row : safeArray(columns).map((columnKey) => row[columnKey]);
                return `
                  <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors align-top">
                    ${cells.map((cell) => `<td class="p-4">${cell === null || cell === undefined || cell === '' ? '<span class="text-slate-300">-</span>' : cell}</td>`).join('')}

          </table>

    }

    function renderBulletList(items, tone) {
      const dotClass = tone === 'dark'
        ? 'bg-report-accent shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(14,165,233,0.55)]'
        : 'bg-report-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.2)]';
      const textClass = tone === 'dark' ? 'text-slate-300' : 'text-slate-700';
      return `
        <ul class="space-y-4">
          ${safeArray(items).map((item) => `
            <li class="flex items-start gap-4 ${textClass}">
              <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${dotClass} mt-2.5 shrink-0"></span>
              <p class="leading-relaxed">${item}</p>
            </li>
          `).join('')}
        </ul>
      `;
    }

    function renderDarkCard(title, text, bullets) {
      return `
        <div class="bg-slate-900 rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border border-slate-800" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-64 h-64 bg-report-accent/10 rounded-full blur-3xl -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3"></div>
          <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-5 relative z-10">${title}</h3>
          ${text ? `<p class="text-slate-300 text-lg font-light leading-relaxed relative z-10 mb-6">${text}</p>` : ''}
          ${safeArray(bullets).length ? `<div class="relative z-10">${renderBulletList(bullets, 'dark')}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderLightCard(title, text, footerHtml) {
      return `
        <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-sm border border-slate-200" data-animate="fade-up">
          <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4">${title}</h3>
          ${text ? `<p class="text-slate-700 text-lg font-light leading-relaxed">${text}</p>` : ''}
          ${footerHtml || ''}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderPieChart(chart) {
      const colors = ['#0ea5e9', '#14b8a6', '#4f46e5', '#f59e0b', '#cbd5e1', '#ef4444'];
      const items = safeArray(chart?.data || chart?.items).map((item, index) => ({
        label: item.label || item.name || `Item ${index + 1}`,
        value: Number(item.value || item.count || item.percentage || 0),
        color: item.color || colors[index % colors.length],
        desc: item.desc || item.description || item.scope || ''
      }));
      const total = Number(chart?.total) || items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.value, 0) || 1;
      let cursor = 0;
      const gradient = items.map((item) => {
        const pct = (item.value / total) * 100;
        const segment = `${item.color} ${cursor}% ${cursor + pct}%`;
        cursor += pct;
        return segment;
      }).join(', ');
      return `
        <div class="flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-8 w-full">
          <div class="w-40 h-40 rounded-full shadow-inner border border-slate-200 flex-shrink-0" style="background: conic-gradient(${gradient})"></div>
          <div class="space-y-4 w-full max-w-sm">
            ${items.map((item) => `
              <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div class="w-4 h-4 rounded-full mt-0.5 shadow-sm shrink-0" style="background-color:${item.color}"></div>
                <div>
                  <p class="font-bold text-slate-800 leading-none">${item.label} <span class="text-slate-500 font-medium ml-1">(${item.value})</span></p>
                  ${item.desc ? `<p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">${item.desc}</p>` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function normalizeProgressItems(items) {
      return safeArray(items).map((item) => ({
        label: item.label || item.name || item.title || 'Item',
        valueA: Number(item.valueA ?? item.current ?? item.di ?? item.score ?? item.value ?? 0),
        valueB: Number(item.valueB ?? item.target ?? item.do ?? 0),
        max: Number(item.max ?? item.maxScore ?? 100) || 100
      }));
    }

    function renderProgressBars(items, options) {
      const normalized = normalizeProgressItems(items);
      const labelA = options?.labelA || 'Current';
      const labelB = options?.labelB || 'Target';
      const colorA = options?.colorA || 'var(--bar-a, #3b82f6)';
      const colorB = options?.colorB || 'var(--bar-b, #14b8a6)';
      return `
        <div class="space-y-6 w-full">
          ${normalized.map((item) => {
            const pctA = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (item.valueA / item.max) * 100));
            const pctB = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (item.valueB / item.max) * 100));
            return `
              <div>
                <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">
                  <span>${item.label}</span>
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">
                    <span class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm" style="background:${colorA}"></span>${labelA}: ${item.valueA}</span>
                    ${item.valueB ? `<span class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm" style="background:${colorB}"></span>${labelB}: ${item.valueB}</span>` : ''}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="space-y-2">
                  <div class="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2.5 overflow-hidden">
                    <div class="score-bar h-2.5 rounded-full" style="background:${colorA};width:0" data-target-width="${pctA.toFixed(2)}"></div>
                  </div>
                  ${item.valueB ? `
                    <div class="w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div class="score-bar h-2 rounded-full" style="background:${colorB};width:0" data-target-width="${pctB.toFixed(2)}"></div>
                    </div>
                  ` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
            `;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderTimeline(phases) {
      return `
        <div class="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-[2rem] p-8 md:p-10 shadow-2xl" data-animate="fade-up">
          <div class="relative timeline-container grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-${Math.min(Math.max(safeArray(phases).length, 1), 4)} gap-8">
            ${safeArray(phases).map((phase, index) => `
              <div class="relative z-10 border-t border-white/10 pt-7">
                <div class="absolute -top-2 left-0 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-900 border-4 border-report-500"></div>
                <p class="text-report-accent font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-xs mb-2">${phase.phase || `Phase ${index + 1}`}</p>
                <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-2">${phase.title || phase.focus || 'Workstream'}</h3>
                ${phase.duration ? `<p class="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-2">${phase.duration}</p>` : ''}
                <p class="text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">${phase.focus || phase.description || phase.text || ''}</p>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderTableFromObjects(items) {
      const rows = safeArray(items);
      if (!rows.length || typeof rows[0] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(rows[0])) return '';
      const keys = Object.keys(rows[0]).filter((key) => !/color|class|template_type/i.test(key));
      return renderDataTable(keys.map((key) => toTitleCase(key)), rows.map((row) => keys.map((key) => row[key] ?? '')));
    }

    function findTableBlock(value, depth) {
      if (depth > 4 || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.length && value.every((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))) {
          const keys = Object.keys(value[0]).filter((key) => !/color|class|template_type/i.test(key));
          if (keys.length >= 2) {
            return {
              columns: keys.map((key) => toTitleCase(key)),
              rows: value.map((row) => keys.map((key) => row[key] ?? ''))
            };
          }
        }
        for (const item of value) {
          const result = findTableBlock(item, depth + 1);
          if (result) return result;
        }
        return null;
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value.columns) && Array.isArray(value.rows)) return { columns: value.columns, rows: value.rows };
      if (Array.isArray(value.headers) && Array.isArray(value.rows)) return { columns: value.headers, rows: value.rows };
      if (value.tableHeaders && value.tableData) return { columns: Object.values(value.tableHeaders), rows: value.tableData.map((row) => Object.keys(value.tableHeaders).map((key) => row[key] ?? '')) };
      if (value.mapping_headers && value.mapping_table) return { columns: Object.values(value.mapping_headers), rows: value.mapping_table.map((row) => Object.keys(value.mapping_headers).map((key) => row[key] ?? '')) };
      if (value.mappingHeaders && value.mappingTable) return { columns: Object.values(value.mappingHeaders), rows: value.mappingTable.map((row) => Object.keys(value.mappingHeaders).map((key) => row[key] ?? '')) };
      for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
        const result = findTableBlock(child, depth + 1);
        if (result) return result;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function findMetricBlocks(value, depth) {
      if (depth > 4 || value === null || value === undefined) return [];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.length && value.every((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && ('label' in item) && ('value' in item))) {
          return value.map((item) => ({ label: item.label, value: item.value, subtext: item.subtext || item.description || '' }));
        }
        for (const item of value) {
          const result = findMetricBlocks(item, depth + 1);
          if (result.length) return result;
        }
        return [];
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return [];
      const nestedMetricMap = Object.values(value)
        .filter((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item) && ('value' in item) && ('label' in item))
        .map((item) => ({ label: item.label, value: item.value, subtext: item.description || '' }));
      if (nestedMetricMap.length) return nestedMetricMap;
      for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
        const result = findMetricBlocks(child, depth + 1);
        if (result.length) return result;
      }
      return [];
    }

    function collectKeyedStrings(value, depth, keyHint) {
      if (depth > 5 || value === null || value === undefined) return [];
      const hint = keyHint || '';
      const goodHint = /text|content|desc|description|summary|statement|takeaway|note|rule|rationale|purpose|context|outlook|subtitle|impact|risk|current|focus|observation/i.test(hint);
      if (typeof value === 'string') return goodHint ? [value] : [];
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.every((item) => typeof item === 'string') && goodHint) return value;
        return value.flatMap((item) => collectKeyedStrings(item, depth + 1, hint));
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return [];
      return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, item]) => collectKeyedStrings(item, depth + 1, key));
    }

    function collectBulletItems(value, depth, keyHint) {
      if (depth > 5 || value === null || value === undefined) return [];
      const hint = keyHint || '';
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (value.every((item) => typeof item === 'string')) return value;
        if (value.every((item) => item && typeof item === 'object' && !Array.isArray(item))) {
          return value.map((item) => summarizeObjectLine(item)).filter(Boolean);
        }
        return value.flatMap((item) => collectBulletItems(item, depth + 1, hint));
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return [];
      return Object.entries(value).flatMap(([key, item]) => {
        if (/items|bullets|gaps|strengths|principles|dependencies|pilots|requirements|lacks|priorities|layers|environment|primaryRisks|rules|facts|levels|scale|sources|implications/i.test(key)) {
          return collectBulletItems(item, depth + 1, key);
        }
        return [];
      });
    }

    function findChartBlock(value, depth) {
      if (depth > 4 || value === null || value === undefined) return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (const item of value) {
          const result = findChartBlock(item, depth + 1);
          if (result) return result;
        }
        return null;
      }
      if (typeof value !== 'object') return null;
      if (value.type === 'pie' || value.type === 'progress') return value;
      for (const child of Object.values(value)) {
        const result = findChartBlock(child, depth + 1);
        if (result) return result;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function normalizeAppendixPayload(data) {
      const rawSections = data.sections || {};
      const sections = Array.isArray(rawSections)
        ? rawSections.map((section, index) => ({
            key: section.key || `section_${index + 1}`,
            title: section.title || section.section_title || section.sectionTitle || section.titleText || `Section ${section.section_number || section.sectionNumber || index + 1}`,
            subtitle: section.subtitle || section.section_subtitle || section.sectionSubtitle || section.subtitleText || '',
            raw: section
          }))
        : Object.entries(rawSections).map(([key, section]) => ({
            key,
            title: section?.title || section?.sectionTitle || section?.titleText || section?.section_title || toTitleCase(key),
            subtitle: section?.subtitle || section?.sectionSubtitle || section?.subtitleText || section?.section_subtitle || '',
            raw: section
          }));

      const findSection = (matcher) => sections.find((section) => matcher((section.title || '').toLowerCase(), section.key.toLowerCase(), section.raw));
      const referenceSection = findSection((title, key) => /reference|output/.test(title) || /reference/.test(key));
      const purposeSection = findSection((title, key) => /purpose/.test(title) || /purpose/.test(key)) || sections[0];
      const overviewSection = findSection((title) => /overview|snapshot|dashboard|landscape|summary/.test(title)) || sections[1];
      const inventorySection = findSection((title, key, raw) => {
        if (referenceSection && raw === referenceSection.raw) return false;
        return (/inventory|register|dictionary|matrix|mapping|coverage/.test(title) || /inventory|register/.test(key)) && Boolean(findTableBlock(raw, 0));
      });
      const riskSection = findSection((title, key) => /risk|maturity|governance/.test(title) || /risk|maturity|governance/.test(key));
      const prioritySection = findSection((title) => /executive|conclusion|framing|implication|priority|target-state/.test(title));
      const observationSections = sections.filter((section) => {
        return ![purposeSection, overviewSection, inventorySection, riskSection, prioritySection, referenceSection].includes(section);
      });

      const purposeTexts = uniqueStrings(collectKeyedStrings(purposeSection?.raw, 0, 'text'));
      const purposeBullets = uniqueStrings(collectBulletItems(purposeSection?.raw, 0, 'items'));
      const overviewMetrics = findMetricBlocks(overviewSection?.raw, 0);
      const overviewBullets = uniqueStrings([
        ...collectBulletItems(overviewSection?.raw, 0, 'items'),
        ...collectKeyedStrings(overviewSection?.raw, 0, 'text')
      ]);
      const inventoryTable = findTableBlock(inventorySection?.raw, 0) || findTableBlock(data.sections, 0);
      const riskTable = findTableBlock(riskSection?.raw, 0);
      const riskItems = uniqueStrings([
        ...collectBulletItems(riskSection?.raw, 0, 'items'),
        ...collectKeyedStrings(riskSection?.raw, 0, 'text')
      ]);
      const priorityItems = uniqueStrings([
        ...collectBulletItems(prioritySection?.raw, 0, 'items'),
        ...collectKeyedStrings(prioritySection?.raw, 0, 'text')
      ]);
      const referenceTable = findTableBlock(referenceSection?.raw, 0);

      const observationCards = observationSections.map((section) => {
        const chart = findChartBlock(section.raw, 0);
        const table = findTableBlock(section.raw, 0);
        const metrics = findMetricBlocks(section.raw, 0);
        const bullets = uniqueStrings(collectBulletItems(section.raw, 0, 'items')).slice(0, 8);
        const texts = uniqueStrings(collectKeyedStrings(section.raw, 0, 'text')).slice(0, 4);
        return {
          title: section.title,
          subtitle: section.subtitle,
          text: texts[0] || '',
          bullets,
          chart,
          table,
          metrics
        };
      }).filter((card) => card.title && (card.text || card.bullets.length || card.table || card.chart || card.metrics.length));

      return {
        metadata: data.metadata || {},
        purpose: {
          title: purposeSection?.title || 'Purpose',
          subtitle: purposeSection?.subtitle || '',
          text: purposeTexts[0] || purposeBullets[0] || 'Structured report content is captured in the embedded dataset.',
          takeaway: purposeSection?.raw?.takeaway || purposeTexts[1] || purposeBullets[1] || ''

      if (family === 'digital-solution') return renderDigitalSolutionFamily(data);
      return renderGenericFamily(data);
    }

    function attachScrollAnimations() {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-animate]').forEach((element) => observer.observe(element));

      const staggerObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            Array.from(entry.target.children).forEach((child, index) => {
              window.setTimeout(() => child.classList.add('is-visible'), index * 80);
            });
            staggerObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.05 });

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-stagger]').forEach((element) => staggerObserver.observe(element));
    }

    function animateProgressBars() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.score-bar[data-target-width]').forEach((bar) => {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          bar.style.width = `${bar.getAttribute('data-target-width')}%`;
        }, 280);
      });
    }

    function attachGaugeAnimations() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.circle[data-filled]').forEach((element) => {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          element.style.strokeDasharray = `${element.getAttribute('data-filled')}, 100`;
        }, 280);
      });
    }

    function initMermaidBlocks() {
      if (!document.querySelector('.mermaid')) return;
      mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: false, theme: 'default', securityLevel: 'loose' });
      mermaid.run({ querySelector: '.mermaid' });
    }

    function initMaturityChart(data) {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('maturity-radar');
      if (!canvas || !data.sections?.maturity?.radarData?.length) return;
      const labels = data.sections.maturity.radarData.map((item) => item.dimension);
      const current = data.sections.maturity.radarData.map((item) => item.current);
      const target = data.sections.maturity.radarData.map((item) => item.target);
      new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'radar',
        data: {
          labels,
          datasets: [
            {
              label: 'Current',
              data: current,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.12)',
              borderColor: '#4f46e5',
              pointBackgroundColor: '#4f46e5',
              borderWidth: 2
            },
            {
              label: 'Target',
              data: target,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.08)',
              borderColor: '#14b8a6',
              pointBackgroundColor: '#14b8a6',
              borderWidth: 2,
              borderDash: [6, 4]
            }
          ]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } },
          scales: { r: { min: 0, max: 5, ticks: { stepSize: 1 } } },
          animation: { duration: 1200, easing: 'easeInOutQuart' }
        }
      });
    }

    function initModuleGalleries() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-gallery-target]').forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const target = button.getAttribute('data-gallery-target');
          const image = button.getAttribute('data-gallery-image');
          const mainImage = document.querySelector(`img[data-gallery="${target}"]`);
          if (mainImage) mainImage.src = image;
          document.querySelectorAll(`[data-gallery-target="${target}"]`).forEach((thumb) => thumb.classList.remove('is-active'));
          button.classList.add('is-active');
        });
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('report-data').textContent);
      const app = document.getElementById('app');
      document.title = data.metadata?.title || 'Report';
      app.innerHTML = buildHTML(data);
      attachScrollAnimations();
      animateProgressBars();
      attachGaugeAnimations();
      initMermaidBlocks();
      initMaturityChart(data);
      initModuleGalleries();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    function safeArray(value) {
      return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    }

    function uniqueStrings(values) {
      return Array.from(new Set(values.filter(Boolean).map((item) => String(item).trim()).filter(Boolean)));
    }

    function toTitleCase(value) {
      return String(value)
        .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim()
        .replace(/\b\w/g, (match) => match.toUpperCase());
    }

    function summarizeObjectLine(value) {
      if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return String(value || '');
      const ignored = new Set(['color', 'colorClass', 'impactClass', 'class', 'style', 'template_type']);
      return Object.entries(value)
        .filter(([key, item]) => !ignored.has(key) && item !== null && item !== undefined && item !== '')
        .map(([key, item]) => {
          if (Array.isArray(item)) return item.join(', ');
          if (typeof item === 'object') return '';
          return key.length <= 3 ? String(item) : `${toTitleCase(key)}: ${item}`;
        })
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' - ');
    }

    function renderSectionTitle(sectionNumber, titleText, subtitleText) {
      return `
        <div class="flex items-stretch gap-4 mb-8" data-animate="fade-up">

            ${subtitleText ? `<p class="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2 max-w-3xl">${subtitleText}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function renderHero(meta, highlights, options) {
      const badge = options?.badge || meta.documentId || meta.scope || meta.solutionCode || meta.systemId || meta.templateFamily || '';
      const subtitle = options?.subtitle || meta.subtitle || meta.company || meta.scope || '';
      const statusLabel = meta.status ? `
        <p class="font-medium text-report-500 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg">
          <span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-report-500 animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]"></span>
          ${meta.status}
        </p>
      ` : '<p class="font-medium text-white text-lg">Prepared Template</p>';
      const cells = [];
      if (options?.leadCell) cells.push(options.leadCell);
      safeArray(highlights).forEach((item) => {
        cells.push(`
          <div>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">${item.label}</p>
            <p class="font-medium text-white text-lg">${item.value}</p>
          </div>
        `);
      });
      if (cells.length < 4) {
        cells.push(`
          <div>
            <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Status</p>
            ${statusLabel}
          </div>
        `);
      }

      return `
        <section class="min-h-[92vh] flex flex-col justify-end p-8 md:p-16 lg:p-24 hero-bg text-white relative" data-animate="zoom-in">
          <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-900/90 via-slate-900/36 to-transparent mix-blend-multiply"></div>
          <div class="relative z-10 max-w-6xl">
            ${badge ? `
              <div class="mb-6 inline-flex items-center px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-report-500/50 bg-report-500/20 text-blue-100 text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase shadow-lg">
                ${badge}
              </div>
            ` : ''}
            <h1 class="text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-4 text-white drop-shadow-sm max-w-5xl">${meta.title || 'Report'}</h1>
            ${subtitle ? `<h2 class="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-light text-slate-300 mb-12 max-w-4xl leading-snug">${subtitle}</h2>` : ''}
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 border-t border-white/20 pt-8 mt-12 dark-glass rounded-[2rem] p-8 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl items-center" data-stagger>
              ${cells.slice(0, 4).join('')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      `;

    function renderMetricGrid(metrics) {

    function renderDataTable(columns, rows, options) {
      const minWidth = options?.minWidth || '1100px';
      return `
        <div class="bg-white rounded-[2rem] shadow-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden table-container overflow-x-auto" data-animate="fade-up">

    function renderBulletList(items, tone) {
      const dotClass = tone === 'dark'
        ? 'bg-report-accent shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(14,165,233,0.55)]'
        : 'bg-report-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.2)]';

    function renderDarkCard(title, text, bullets) {
